about: Invented notes and statement drafts for the A4 matcher (25 Nov 2026). Every note, name and draft here was made up for this file: none comes from a real account or a real child. note: one entry per note unit, joined by joiner. outcomes: each 'What I saw' as sentences [text, gold]; strategy is the educator's reading and never judged. gold as in stories.json. Labelled by hand before lib/source-lines.ts existed. Split: odd positions tune, even positions held out.
